messages:
Natalie: Heads-up: planning v2 rollout TOMORROW 09:00 PT, 2h change window. Main change is structured responses + header gate (X-API-Version). Need mobile SDK min-version pin list and release notes. Any blockers?

Raj: Can we do regional staging? start US, then EU, then APAC if green. prefer small canaries.

Chris: +1. We'll drive via gateway feature flags. Plan: canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 100 by region. Gateway will honor X-API-Version header for explicit routing.

Natalie: Client teams: send me list of SDK versions still on v1 by EOD. Mobile PM suggests pinning <2.3 to v1 until we confirm.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled v2-rollout job created (id: rb-2024-1744). Runbook: /playbooks/v2-rollout. Canary windows auto-fail on SLO breach.

Chris: Quick routing rule we plan to use:
```
# pseudo
if req.headers['x-api-version'] == 'v2' or client.sdk_version >= '2.3':
  route -> v2
else:
  route -> v1
```
We'll implement semver-safe compare in gateway.

Sam: SRE: I'll add alerts: 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m, p95 latency increase > 40ms. Oncall will be ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary: 1% traffic -> v2 (us-west) at 2024-04-08T16:00:00Z

Sam: eu-west canary showing spike in 502s ~16:07. small sample from edge logs:
```
[2024-04-08T16:07:12Z] gateway-edge-12: upstream returned 502 on /v2/generate, conn reset by peer
[2024-04-08T16:07:13Z] gateway-edge-12: client-sdk=1.9.3 payload_len=512k
```
Pattern looks correlated to older mobile SDKs chunked uploads.

Chris: Pause rollout and rollback eu-west to v1. Do NOT promote other regions.

Raj: Spin up hotfix: gateway should pin traffic from mobile SDK versions <2.3 to v1 explicitly. Can we inject a header-based short-circuit?

Chris: Patching gateway now. Will add semver check + static pin list override. Patch id #3489.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed in eu-west at 2024-04-08T16:23:05Z (rb-2024-1744, step: regional-rollback).

Natalie: Update release notes: mention regional rollback and that mobile SDKs <2.3 are pinned to v1 until client upgrades. Action items: outreach to Mobile Eng & Support, update changelog, set follow-up retro.

Sam: Root cause hypothesis: older SDK chunking + gateway keepalive edge-case causing upstream to drop connection -> 502. Will gather traces and confirm.

Chris: After hotfix we can re-do US canary with explicit SDK-version routing only. Mobile pin will remain until we see no 5xx in 24h.

Natalie: Thanks all. Mobile PM please send target upgrade plan. I'll draft a short status note for customers and ops. :white_check_mark:
